links.outcome: Variation in AI tool performance and use across hospital sites and use cases
links.effect: Qualitative finding of contextual variation in VLN performance and use between different hospital sites and use cases; performance was variable, affected by workflow integration, technical configuration and infrastructure.
links.quote: There were contextual variations in tool performance and use between different hospital sites and different use cases.

links.outcome: Differences between expert and novice users in critically evaluating AI recommendations
links.effect: Experts critically evaluated system recommendations and compensated for system limitations to achieve more reliable performance; novice users differed in patterns of use. No quantitative error-detection rates reported.
links.quote: There were differences in patterns of use between experts and novice users with experts critically evaluating system recommendations and actively compensating for system limitations to achieve more reliable performance.

screen.reason: Qualitative study of early real-world implementation experiences across clinical deployment sites using an AI imaging decision support system (Veye Lung Nodules).
